entry.title: Würzburg Residence

groundCutout.basis: Hole-free occupied palace strips and western entrance apron only; four actual court holes, Ehrenhof, garden approaches and town ground remain original.

buildingCutout.basis: Q156316 and named Residenz Würzburg POI identify OpenStreetMap relation7074/native52776558140322. Own this one complete connected parent only; no additional overlapping building records in the standard extract. Its39-vertex outer boundary and four actual court holes supply scale. Origin is the midpoint of western central facade edge32→33. Internal X south/slightly west along the west front; Z west/slightly north into Ehrenhof. Baked native east/up/south axes, heading0. Hole-free ownership/ground partitions retain all four original court grounds, the open forecourt and independent city buildings; no outline is allowed to fill a court.

terrainReference.basis: Qualified approximate native palace exterior fit on original Protomaps20261020/Mapzen201x201/6m ground. Open Ehrenhof provider[0,10] supplies188.94774001662032m datum. Boundary grades-2.798..+.482m; floor+.2m and foundation-2.978m provide supported bases with up to about3m of low-side plinth exposure and modest high-side burial. Four actual court holes and open forecourt retain original terrain; their exact historic paving/levels remain approximate. A closed raised western apron supports four front columns and thresholds; recessed side colonnades retain original adjoining ground. Four hole-free occupied partitions plus apron mask remove only palace contact ground. All independent town buildings, garden approaches, roads and water remain intact. Native views establish approximate contact; flat review planes partly bury grade-specific bases. No bespoke terrain/survey or flattening; exact thresholds and accessibility unverified.
